title: Auto Loans: delinquency and charge-off day thresholds
content:
# Auto Loans: delinquency and charge-off day thresholds

This quick reference gives the two days-past-due thresholds of each Auto Loans product at PCB: the days past due at which the loan becomes delinquent, and the days past due at which the remaining principal is charged off.

| Auto Loans product | Becomes delinquent at (days past due) | Remaining principal charged off at (days past due) |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 30 | 120 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 30 | 120 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 30 | 120 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 30 | 120 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 30 | 120 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 30 | 120 |

## Illustration (hypothetical days-past-due readings, any product)

| Days past due | Delinquency threshold of 30 reached? | Charge-off threshold of 120 reached? |
|---|---|---|
| 29 | no | no |
| 30 | yes | no |
| 119 | yes | no |
| 120 | yes | yes |
